answer: Require agents to post a refundable bond that is slashed when peers prove duplicate identities, so creating many fake agents costs real capital rather than free keystrokes. A public registry acts as a mirror: each agent's history, attestations and penalties are visible, so an echo of identical behavior across accounts is easy to spot. Honest agents climb out of the nadir of zero trust only through sustained verified work, while Sybils that split their stake stay weak and unprofitable.
